content: Maro Kindeni ikai koipu ŋalae panzi tamâta ndoni
Miki tamâta ŋai, miki kawâŋgi wâŋgiŋa wasaseki pa Yova Kindeni, ŋana tu ina iveta vetâŋa ŋalaŋala arara nâ. I ne walo kaika nde ŋalae; mine kala i tamwata ipole paraŋa lâ.
Yova Kindeni itula pwataki tu inani ipole paraŋa lâ. Itula pwataki panzi tamâta ŋgu ndoni tu inani ikai kinda piti lâ kazâŋa ilo.

I iyoka tamwata ne ŋgua pâŋa muŋgâŋa muli, kala ikura zo zo i uru tini mwasa ndo panzi Isrel ŋgu. I ŋandai ipilenzi ŋga. Mine kala tamâta rârâni simo tâno ndoni nde simora tu kinda nenda Maro Kindeni ipole paraŋa marumbu lâ.
Miki tamâta rârâni kamo tâno kulu, miki kandeka ku kawâŋgi wâŋgiŋa paneâŋa kâ kandekana Yova Kindeni! Kawâŋgi kawami kâki ku kandeka kapanea i ŋa kasuka kâki!
Kara wâŋgu ku kawâŋgi wâŋgiŋa paneâŋa kâ pa Yova Kindeni. Kawâŋgi wâŋgiŋa kaŋa ara nâ papa.
Kambana tando kie-kie ku kasarâwa kandekana Yova Kindeni, inani kinda nenda Koipu Ŋalae.
Aŋga tâi tava kelekele rârâni kamo tâi ilo, miki kala kaveta nduŋeŋa kasuŋa kawami kâki. Aŋga tâno tavanzi tamâta rârâni kamo tâno kulu, miki kala kawâŋgi wâŋgiŋa mine nâ.
Miki lââ ŋalaŋala kaponza mbaumi, aŋga miki tuu ŋalaŋala kala kagogo kawami kawâŋgi wâŋgiŋa ndekâŋa kâ lâ Yova Kindeni nao.
Ŋana tu muli ŋga, i ma imâ ŋana ikai poe panzi tamâta rârâni. I ma ikai poe sondo panzi tamâta rârâni tava vetâŋa sondo nâ.
